subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve inbound messages across restarts

question: Should WhatsApp intentionally drop an inbound turn after bounded durable-persistence retries rather than fall back to immediate live dispatch that bypasses shared dedupe and per-conversation serialization?
rationale: This is an explicit delivery-availability versus durable-ordering policy choice; the repository policy treats fallback removal and fail-closed behavior as maintainer decisions rather than implementation conveniences.

options.title: Keep fail-closed durable ingress
options.body: Approve the shared-drain invariant after a credentialed restart proof confirms that normal durable recovery and ordering work end to end.

options.title: Preserve an availability fallback
options.body: Request a narrowly defined fallback only if maintainers accept the duplicate and ordering risks or can provide an equally durable alternative.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Defer this channel adapter until the delivery policy and live WhatsApp test credential are available.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed durable ingress
recommendation.body: Approve the shared-drain invariant after a credentialed restart proof confirms that normal durable recovery and ordering work end to end.

likelyOwner.reason: The related rollout and the durable-drain base commit establish the contract whose fallback policy is being applied to WhatsApp.
